nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Cole. Good. The workshop door's been squeaking in E flat and it's ruining my concentration.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: See, THIS is why you're my favourite outlaw. Now hush and listen.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Word is Vane's bank is holding papers that don't belong to it. Farm deeds. Signed in handwriting suspiciously like Vane's.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Nothing we can do about it today. But a wise woman keeps her tools sharp. Go knock the dust off your aim — the practice rail's still standing, barely.

choices.text: And if the practice sign breaks?

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Then it'll finally match everything else Vane's touched in this town.
